Definition: a Caphtorite (collectively) or native of Caphtor
BiblicalUsage: The Caphtorim are the people of Caphtor, named in the table of nations and in the story of the Avims, whom the Caphtorims destroyed and replaced.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the Caphtorim, named only in genealogies and histories, show that God keeps the record of peoples who never knew Him.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
